title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #19

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which element is called Vayu? (1 mark)
   A. Fire
   B. Earth
   C. Space
   D. Air

2. Which tree is linked with Lord Mahavir's enlightenment? (1 mark)
   A. Tulsi
   B. Sal tree
   C. Banana tree
   D. Ber tree

3. What is a kaand in the Ramayan? (1 mark)
   A. A section or book of the Ramayan
   B. A festival
   C. A river
   D. A prayer

4. What promise lesson do we learn from the Ayodhya Kaand? (1 mark)
   A. Break promises
   B. Keep your promises
   C. Forget promises
   D. Promises are for kings only

5. Which scripture is a Jain book about the life of Lord Mahavir? (1 mark)
   A. Kalpasutra
   B. Ramayan
   C. Guru Granth Sahib
   D. Dhammapada

6. What does the veena stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth
   B. Rain
   C. War
   D. Music and the arts

7. What does Saraswati hold in her hands in pictures? (1 mark)
   A. A veena and a book
   B. A sword and a shield
   C. A bow and arrow
   D. A drum and a flag

8. Which is a benefit of praying every day? (1 mark)
   A. It teaches discipline
   B. It stops all rain
   C. It makes us taller
   D. It makes homework disappear

9. What does Vandana mean? (1 mark)
   A. A tree
   B. A river
   C. A meal
   D. An act of respect and prayer

10. What is prasad? (1 mark)
   A. Blessed food shared after prayers
   B. A kind of shoe
   C. A prayer book
   D. A garden

11. What should you do if you see something online that makes you uncomfortable? (1 mark)
   A. Tell a trusted adult
   B. Share it with friends
   C. Put it back where you found it
   D. Keep clicking

12. Which statement about integrity is true? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for big things
   B. It is only for teachers
   C. It includes small daily choices
   D. It is only for adults

13. Which faith's story in the lesson is about truth and a king? (1 mark)
   A. Sikhism
   B. Buddhism
   C. Hinduism
   D. Jainism

14. What is a skit? (1 mark)
   A. A short act showing a story
   B. A game with rules
   C. A map
   D. A dance only

15. Which is a benefit of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. People trust us
   B. People avoid us
   C. We feel afraid
   D. We are always angry

16. On which date is International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. 12 December
   B. 25 December
   C. 1 June
   D. 21 June

17. How should the back be in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Straight
   B. Twisted
   C. Bent
   D. Round

18. Which is an act of Prani Daya? (1 mark)
   A. Wasting food
   B. Throwing stones at a dog
   C. Breaking plants
   D. Giving water to a thirsty animal

19. To what does the Bhagavad Gita compare the soul in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A stone
   C. A tree
   D. A person who changes old clothes for new

20. What did King Shibi offer to save the dove? (1 mark)
   A. His own flesh, weight for weight
   B. His horse
   C. His shoes
   D. His crown

21. Which important idea about the Purusharthas is taught? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth is all that matters
   B. Ignore Dharma
   C. Balance, with wealth and wishes following Dharma
   D. Wishes come first

22. Which is a reason for celebrating festivals? (1 mark)
   A. To waste time
   B. To remember important events and teachings
   C. To avoid friends
   D. To stop learning

23. Which of these is NOT true about the flag? (1 mark)
   A. It is raised at ceremonies
   B. It is a national symbol
   C. It should be respected
   D. It may touch the ground

24. In which months of the usual calendar does Maha Shivratri usually fall? (1 mark)
   A. October or November
   B. December or January
   C. July or August
   D. February or March

25. Which day is linked with Mercury? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Sunday
   C. Friday
   D. Tuesday

26. Shani is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Venus
   C. Saturn
   D. Jupiter

27. Which two heavenly bodies besides the five planets are counted as grahas? (1 mark)
   A. The Sun and the Moon
   B. The stars and clouds
   C. Earth and Pluto
   D. The Sun and Earth

28. Shukra is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Saturn
   B. Mars
   C. Mercury
   D. Venus

29. Which day is linked with Saturn? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. Saturday
   C. Monday
   D. Thursday

30. Which is a use of the Panchang? (1 mark)
   A. Counting rainfall
   B. Fixing the dates of festivals
   C. Cooking rice
   D. Keeping the school timetable

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain what we learn from the lives of any two Enlightened Beings. (4 marks)

32. Describe how the Bodhi tree is linked with the Buddha. (3 marks)

33. Write a short composition on a festival of your choice. (5 marks)

34. Explain the meaning of Kapaal Bhaati. (3 marks)

35. Explain the main teachings of the Dhammapada. (3 marks)

36. Explain what Maha Shivratri teaches. (4 marks)

37. Name the two Jain scriptures in this lesson. (2 marks)

38. Describe the four things a person may do at a Mandir and what each shows. (4 marks)

39. Write three signs of integrity at school. (3 marks)

40. Tell the story of the Ayodhya Kaand in three sentences. (3 marks)

41. State three reasons why the Saraswati Vandana is said by students. (3 marks)

42. Explain why the Indian traditional calendar is special and how a child can use it. (5 marks)

43. Explain the meaning of karma. (3 marks)

44. Which day is Shanivaar and which planet is it linked with? (2 marks)

45. List three ideal practices of a passenger while travelling. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Air
   Vayu means air and wind.

2. B — Sal tree
   Jains say Lord Mahavir became enlightened under a sal tree.

3. A — A section or book of the Ramayan
   The Ramayan is divided into kaands.

4. B — Keep your promises
   Ram kept his father's promise.

5. A — Kalpasutra
   The Kalpasutra tells the life of Lord Mahavir.

6. D — Music and the arts
   It is a musical instrument.

7. A — A veena and a book
   The veena and the book.

8. A — It teaches discipline
   Doing it regularly teaches discipline.

9. D — An act of respect and prayer
   Vandana is respectful prayer.

10. A — Blessed food shared after prayers
   Prasad is blessed food.

11. A — Tell a trusted adult
   A trusted adult can help.

12. C — It includes small daily choices
   Small choices count.

13. C — Hinduism
   The Harishchandra story.

14. A — A short act showing a story
   Skits help us learn lessons.

15. A — People trust us
   Honest people are trusted.

16. D — 21 June
   21 June.

17. A — Straight
   A straight back is important.

18. D — Giving water to a thirsty animal
   Kindness to living beings.

19. D — A person who changes old clothes for new
   The body is like worn clothes.

20. A — His own flesh, weight for weight
   He offered himself.

21. C — Balance, with wealth and wishes following Dharma
   Dharma guides the others.

22. B — To remember important events and teachings
   Festivals help us remember.

23. D — It may touch the ground
   The flag should never touch the ground.

24. D — February or March
   Phalguna usually falls then.

25. A — Wednesday
   Budhvaar.

26. C — Saturn
   Shani is Saturn.

27. A — The Sun and the Moon
   The seven days link to Sun, Moon and five planets.

28. D — Venus
   Shukra is Venus.

29. B — Saturday
   Shanivaar.

30. B — Fixing the dates of festivals
   It lists festival dates.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Any two, for example: from Prahlad's story that faith and honesty can defeat pride, and from Siddhartha that we must be kind to hurt animals.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each being with a correct lesson.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Prince Siddhartha sat under a Bodhi tree at Bodh Gaya and became the Buddha, the Awakened One. Buddhists honour the tree because of this.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the tree, 1 mark for Siddhartha, 1 mark for enlightenment or Bodh Gaya.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any well-organised composition naming the festival, when it is held, what people do, what it teaches and how you feel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for name, timing, activities, meaning, and feeling.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kapaal means forehead and bhaati means shining, so it means shining forehead. The breath goes out in short pushes and breathing in happens by itself.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for meaning, quick breath out and automatic breath in.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Our thoughts shape our actions, hatred is ended by love, control of anger is strength, and doing good brings peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each teaching, up to 3.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Self-control through fasting, faith through prayer, staying alert to do good, and thinking about our mistakes and trying to be better.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kalpasutra and Uttaradhyayan Sutra.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: Darshan shows respect, aarti offers light, prasad shows blessing and sharing, bhajans show love in song.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Not cheating, owning up to mistakes, handing in lost items, telling the truth, doing your own work (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dasharatha was about to hand the kingdom to Ram, but Kaikeyi asked that Bharat be king and Ram go to the forest for fourteen years. Ram accepted calmly and left with Sita and Lakshman. Bharat placed Ram's sandals on the throne and ruled in his name.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three correct points.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: To ask for a clear mind, good speech and love for reading, music and the arts (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: It links daily life to the sky and seasons, keeps tradition alive and fixes festival dates. A child can make a weekly plan, a decorated calendar, greeting cards or a song.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for why it is special and 3 marks for uses.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Karma means action. Good actions bring good results and unkind actions bring trouble.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for action, 1 mark for good, 1 mark for unkind.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Saturday, linked with Saturn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wear the seat belt, sit still, keep hands and head inside, keep the aisle clear, do not litter, do not distract the driver, give up your seat (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
